facts.text: Morrisville’s Noyes House Museum, a Federal‑style brick mansion, hosts summer concerts by the Morrisville Military Band founded in 1895.
Concept2, the global maker of indoor rowing machines, keeps its headquarters right in the heart of Morrisville.
Copley Hospital, opened in 1932 to serve the Lamoille region, has been a cornerstone of community health ever since.
The Morrisville Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic Places, showcases preserved Federal‑style architecture from the village’s industrial past.
The arrival of the Portland and Ogdensburg railroad in 1872 connected Morrisville to broader trade routes and spurred local economic growth.
Morrisville sits on both sides of the Lamoille River, with its village center on the south bank.
